title: columns@1: one language's column of the meaning matrix
description: meaning/columns/<language>.jsonl. The first line is the header; every later line renders one sentence of sentences@1 as tokens that point back at meaning@1 ids.

language.description: The language id; must match the file name and a folder in languages/.

notes.description: How the column is written: readings, glued pieces, word order.

sep.description: What goes between words: " ", or "" for languages written without spaces.

t.description: Tokens [text, reading, meanings]. A leading "-" glues text to the token before, a trailing "-" to the one after. reading is the romanization or kana, or "" when the text is already romanized. meanings is a meaning@1 id, or several joined with "+".

implied.description: Content meanings the language leaves to context; a learner's English may leave them out.
